article.title: Donnarumma & Guehi highlight Man City issues as solid Arsenal move level
article.summary: Manchester City's 100% winning start to the Premier League season comes to an abrupt end against Aston Villa - leaving Enzo Maresca with glaring defensive issues to resolve.
